name: A1 mini printer

requirements.text: Home X/Y/Z through the endstop cables, reach print temperature with the hotend read as a beta-model NTC, execute the X/Y/Z/E path, render the display through its cable, count all commanded STEP pulses, and finish with drivers, heaters, and fan safe.
Hotend over-temperature after the print is caught: the firmware reports FAULT OVERTEMP and holds heater, bed and fan gates low and the drivers disabled.

model_boundary: Homing, step-command counts, OLED rendering and an overtemperature fail-safe are verified in the firmware twin; live machine mechanics, PCB-to-assembly equivalence, true extrusion and physical printer operation are not.
